title.zh: 克洛丽 · 风化铺垫与毁伤合轴
title.en: Claret / Roxy / Rina · Windswept setup and Maim overlap

summary.zh: 本站依据璐洛洛正文与固定机制整理：洛克茜铺风化，丽娜交快支，克拉蕾按残痕衔接毁伤；丽娜潜能按配置处理。非作者逐帧原轴。
summary.en: DUKE synthesis of Ruroro’s text and fixed mechanics: Roxy establishes Windswept, Rina offers an assist, and Claret links Maim using actual Gash; Rina Potential follows configuration. Not the author’s frame-by-frame timeline.

conditions.zh: 循环站位洛克茜→丽娜→克拉蕾，可整体旋转；丽娜向下一位交快支，克拉蕾向下一位切洛克茜招架。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Roxy → Rina → Claret, allowing rotations; Rina hands Quick Assist forward, and Claret switches forward to Roxy for a parry.

conditions.zh: 基础0影无专武可用；不预设开局3风能、满残痕或所有Q就绪。
conditions.en: Usable at M0 without signatures; do not assume three opening Wind Energy, full Gash or every Ultimate ready.

conditions.zh: 丽娜潜能按0至6阶区分：0阶没有自动清扫或攻防加成；1阶开启自动清扫，2阶起按当前穿透率提供有条件攻防，不能直接套上限。
conditions.en: Rina Potential follows ranks 0–6: rank 0 has no automatic Cleanup or ATK/DEF bonus; rank 1 enables Cleanup, and rank 2+ grants conditional ATK/DEF from her current PEN Ratio, not automatic cap values.

conditions.zh: 洛克茜的电属性增益按目标真实浸染／净化状态检查；只开风化不代表电增益已全部齐。
conditions.en: Check actual Electric Contamination/Cleanse for Roxy’s Electric buffs; Windswept alone does not prove all Electric buffs are active.

conditions.zh: 借鉴3.2旧版手法并交叉固定3.3机制；不继承当时分数、最优排名、固定双连携或特定Boss第三黄光／角力条件。
conditions.en: Older 3.2 methods are cross-checked against fixed 3.3 mechanics; historical scores, rankings, guaranteed double Chains and specific Boss flashes/contests are not inherited.

label.zh: 璐洛洛 · 克拉蕾图文教学（3.2）
璐洛洛 · 洛克茜与克洛丽实战教学（3.2）
label.en: Ruroro · Roxy and Claret/Roxy/Rina written guide (3.2)

objective.zh: 先铺辅助，克拉蕾再开形态积残痕。
objective.en: Establish supports, then Claret activates her state and builds Gash.

prep.zh: 洛克茜先看能量与真实风化；丽娜已经有人偶覆盖可少放EX，但仍须实际把克拉蕾切入。
prep.en: Roxy checks Energy and actual Windswept; existing dolls may save Rina EX, but Claret must still actually enter.

prep.zh: 辅助不足不假定全增益；先完成能执行的基础动作，再回循环刷新。
prep.en: Missing support does not count as full buffs; execute legal base actions and refresh in the next loop.

title.zh: 洛克茜转圈，确认风化与资源再收招
title.en: Roxy spins, then ends on verified Windswept and resources

input.zh: 能量足时长按E贴近目标；松E并停方向，让炮击接出后切丽娜。
input.en: Hold EX near the target with sufficient Energy; release EX and stop movement, then switch to Rina after the cannon is committed.

trigger.zh: 目标能命中，且需要风化、增益刷新或失衡；已有覆盖可缩短。
trigger.en: A hittable target needs Windswept, buff refresh or Daze; shorten setup if already covered.

complete.zh: 每耗25能量得1风能，最多3；炮击后满足总数才抛锤，实际同时引爆3风眼才有巨型风涡。
complete.en: Every 25 Energy spent grants one Wind Energy, max three. The throw needs the combined resource threshold; a giant vortex needs three Eyes actually detonated together.

reason.zh: 开场40能量不等于已有3风能；基础合轴从收招后开始。
reason.en: Opening 40 Energy does not mean three Wind Energy; the base overlap begins after ending the spin.

fallback.zh: 没能量不强转；普通切丽娜继续准备。收招不明确就等炮击／抛锤完成，勿套用2影后台续转。
fallback.en: Without Energy, switch normally to Rina and continue setup. If commitment is unclear, wait for the cannon/throw; do not assume M2 off-field spinning.

signal.zh: 松E且停方向，炮击／抛锤已接出后普通切丽娜。
signal.en: Release EX and movement, then switch normally once the cannon/throw is committed.

title.zh: 丽娜派出人偶，再交克拉蕾
title.en: Dispatch Rina’s dolls, then hand to Claret

input.zh: 需要刷新且能量足时点EX，命中后按实际提示交克拉蕾。
input.en: Use EX when refresh is needed and affordable; hand to Claret through the actual prompt after hitting.

trigger.zh: 丽娜在前台；检查人偶是否已经返回，不按永久增益处理。
trigger.en: Rina is active; check whether the dolls returned rather than assuming permanent coverage.

complete.zh: 人偶攻击给核心穿透，两个都返回就结束；潜能1阶起可自动续攻击，2阶起攻防另看所选阶数。
complete.en: Attacking dolls supply core PEN, ending when both return; Potential rank 1 adds automatic attacks, while rank 2+ ATK/DEF follows the selected rank.

reason.zh: 把辅助刷新放在克拉蕾后台续招时；支援类别以实际提示为准。
reason.en: Refresh support during Claret’s committed off-field attack; use the actual type of entry prompt.

fallback.zh: EX不可用可用普通普攻／特殊技派人偶，再普通切克拉蕾并跳过下一支援事件；已有覆盖也须明确切回。
fallback.en: Without EX, dispatch dolls with normal Basic/Special, then switch normally to Claret and skip the next assist event; existing coverage still requires returning to her.

signal.zh: EX结束出现克拉蕾快支提示才接；无提示普通切回并跳过快支事件。
signal.en: Take Claret’s actual Quick Assist after EX ends; otherwise switch normally and skip the assist event.

title.zh: 克拉蕾按当前形态接快支
title.en: Claret takes the Quick Assist matching her state

input.zh: 在真实快支提示内切克拉蕾，不额外重复普通切人。
input.en: Switch to Claret through the real Quick Assist prompt, without a second normal switch.

trigger.zh: 丽娜EX已给提示，克拉蕾尚未进入猩红铭刻。
trigger.en: Rina EX offered the prompt and Claret is not in Crimson Inscription.

complete.zh: 确认本人接手与剩余形态，不把普通快支当作开状态。
complete.en: Confirm the entrant and remaining state; Quick Assist does not activate Crimson Inscription.

reason.zh: 后台会暂停猩红计时，但不会凭空恢复已耗尽的状态。
reason.en: Off-field time pauses Crimson Inscription but does not restore an expired state.

fallback.zh: 若已经猩红就用实际猩红快支或普通切入，并跳过开状态EX；无提示只普通切入。
fallback.en: If already Crimson, take its actual Quick Assist or switch normally and skip the activation EX; without a prompt, switch normally.

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

input.zh: 非猩红且锐能足时点EX，随后按普攻接第三段。
input.en: Outside Crimson with enough Sharpness, tap EX, then press Basic to link to its third hit.

trigger.zh: 尚未处于猩红铭刻；开局锐能只按真实一次性资源计算。
trigger.en: Crimson Inscription is not active; count opening Sharpness only as its actual one-time grant.

complete.zh: 确认进入16秒猩红铭刻；后台暂停计时，不等于每次切人重置16秒。
complete.en: Confirm 16-second Crimson Inscription; off-field time pauses it rather than resetting it on every switch.

reason.zh: 先建立伤害形态，再积残痕与毁伤。
reason.en: Establish the damage state before building Gash and triggering Maim.

fallback.zh: 已经猩红就跳过；锐能不足先用合法普通连段积攒，不把丽娜普通回能当作锐能。
fallback.en: Skip if already Crimson; without Sharpness, build through legal normal attacks rather than treating Rina’s ordinary Energy as Sharpness.

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

title.zh: 用锻星积残痕，失衡前保留3层
title.en: Build Gash with Starforging; keep three before Stun

input.zh: 合法衔接第三段后长按／连按普攻；松开会跳劈收尾。
input.en: After a legal link to the third Basic, hold/tap Basic to extend it; releasing ends with the leap slash.

trigger.zh: 猩红铭刻仍有效；从EX后可接第三段，否则按正常连段进入。
trigger.en: Crimson Inscription remains active; EX links to the third Basic, otherwise reach it through the normal combo.

complete.zh: 按目标实际残痕计数，最多3层；只有成功极限闪避才计闪避收益。
complete.en: Read actual target Gash, max three; count dodge benefits only after a successful Perfect Dodge.

reason.zh: 积蓄受配置和命中影响，不用固定普攻次数保证满层。
reason.en: Buildup depends on configuration and hits, so no fixed Basic count guarantees full stacks.

fallback.zh: 状态结束就用可用EX重开；目标移动就先追近，临近失衡时保留已攒残痕。
fallback.en: If the state expires, reactivate with an available EX; approach a moving target and preserve Gash near Stun.

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

title.zh: 远离失衡时单毁伤，再接伏钺
title.en: Outside the burst window, use one Maim then Subduing Axe

input.zh: 猩红中点E；真实毁伤成功后按普攻伏钺，再接锻星第三段。
input.en: Tap Special in Crimson; after a successful Maim, press Basic for Subduing Axe, then Starforging’s third hit.

trigger.zh: 目标至少1残痕且离计划爆发仍远；不在即将失衡时主动清空库存。
trigger.en: The target has at least one Gash and the burst is not imminent; do not empty reserves just before Stun.

complete.zh: 横斩命中并消耗1残痕才算毁伤；没有触发就不假定伏钺派生成立。
complete.en: Only a connecting horizontal slash spending one Gash counts as Maim; without it, do not assume the Subduing Axe link.

reason.zh: 以实际毁伤衔接回资源段，避免残痕长期溢出。
reason.en: Return to buildup from a real Maim, avoiding prolonged Gash overflow.

fallback.zh: 临近失衡或残痕不足就跳过，保留资源；状态结束先按开局EX恢复。
fallback.en: Skip near Stun or without Gash and keep resources; restore an expired state with the opening EX.

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

objective.zh: 前台积残痕、招架补失衡，按需刷新辅助。
objective.en: Build Gash on field, parry for Daze and refresh support as needed.

prep.zh: 目标将失衡时优先留3残痕；不为固定普攻次数错过实际窗口。
prep.en: Preserve three Gash near Stun; do not miss the actual window while chasing a fixed Basic count.

prep.zh: 辅助仍覆盖可跳过洛克茜／丽娜刷新并留克拉蕾；已切辅助则仍须明确切回。洛克茜本人Q可用时可在窗外补1风能，不强占输出窗。
prep.en: If support holds, skip refresh and keep Claret active; after switching away, explicitly return. A ready Roxy Ultimate may add one Wind Energy outside the damage window without crowding it.

title.zh: 用锻星积残痕，失衡前保留3层
title.en: Build Gash with Starforging; keep three before Stun

input.zh: 合法衔接第三段后长按／连按普攻；松开会跳劈收尾。
input.en: After a legal link to the third Basic, hold/tap Basic to extend it; releasing ends with the leap slash.

trigger.zh: 猩红铭刻仍有效；从EX后可接第三段，否则按正常连段进入。
trigger.en: Crimson Inscription remains active; EX links to the third Basic, otherwise reach it through the normal combo.

complete.zh: 按目标实际残痕计数，最多3层；只有成功极限闪避才计闪避收益。

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

signal.zh: 真实可招架黄光且支援点足时切洛克茜；否则普通切她并跳过招架事件。
signal.en: Switch to Roxy on an actual parryable flash with Assist Points; otherwise switch normally and skip the Defensive Assist event.

title.zh: 洛克茜接真实招架，再支援突击
title.en: Roxy takes a real Defensive Assist, then follows up

input.zh: 可招架攻击将至时切洛克茜，成功后按普攻接午夜守则。
input.en: Switch to Roxy before a parryable hit; after success press Basic for Midnight Code.

trigger.zh: 存在真实可招架攻击与足够支援点；不是克拉蕾特定敌人的反制角力。
trigger.en: A real parryable attack and sufficient Assist Points exist; this is not Claret’s enemy-specific Counter Assist contest.

complete.zh: 确认招架成功再接支援突击；之后按能量决定EX。
complete.en: Confirm the parry before its Follow-Up, then check Energy for EX.

reason.zh: 利用敌方攻击补失衡，不人为等待固定第几道黄光。
reason.en: Use an enemy attack for Daze without waiting for a fixed numbered flash.

fallback.zh: 无招架条件就普通切洛克茜并直接进入下一EX检查，不计招架收益。
fallback.en: Without a legal parry, switch normally and proceed to the EX check without claiming parry benefits.

objective.zh: 毁伤余段与人偶刷新重叠，连携与Q只按真实窗口。
objective.en: Overlap committed Maim cuts with doll refresh; Chains and Ultimates use actual windows.

prep.zh: 预先准备猩红、目标3残痕、实际风化／电浸染与人偶覆盖；主流程不是保证两轮三毁伤。
prep.en: Prepare Crimson, three target Gash, actual Windswept/Electric Contamination and doll coverage; this does not guarantee two sets of three Maims.

prep.zh: 只有真实失衡重击／连携提示才进连携事件；没有提示就普通回克拉蕾继续，不以普通快支冒充连携。
prep.en: Enter the Chain event only on an actual Stun-heavy-hit/Chain prompt; otherwise return normally to Claret without relabeling Quick Assist as Chain.

title.zh: 满残痕长E，首次毁伤后再合轴
title.en: Hold Special at full Gash; overlap only after the first Maim

input.zh: 猩红中长按E，经上挑进入三横斩；第一次毁伤确实出现后再普通切丽娜。
input.en: Hold Special in Crimson through the upward slash into three horizontal cuts; switch normally to Rina only after the first Maim actually occurs.

trigger.zh: 目标有3残痕、猩红有效且可命中；窗口将开或已开，辅助需要刷新。
trigger.en: The target has three Gash, Crimson is active and hits can connect; the window is opening/open and support needs refresh.

complete.zh: 确认首次毁伤与后续旋转已接出即可切；后台余段只按实际继续并命中计数。
complete.en: Switch only after the first Maim and committed continuation; count later off-field cuts only if they actually continue and connect.

reason.zh: 原作者明确过早切人可能只打一次，不能按按住E就预支三次毁伤。
reason.en: The author warns early switching may leave only one cut; holding Special alone does not earn three Maims.

fallback.zh: 不确定续招就等三段打完再切；不足3残痕先补，窗口太短则点E消耗现有残痕。
fallback.en: If continuation is uncertain, finish all cuts before switching. Build missing Gash, or use single cuts when the window is too short.

signal.zh: 首次毁伤确认、续招已接出后普通切丽娜；不伪装快支。
signal.en: After confirmed first Maim and committed continuation, switch normally to Rina; this is not a Quick Assist.

title.zh: 丽娜派出人偶，再交克拉蕾
title.en: Dispatch Rina’s dolls, then hand to Claret

input.zh: 需要刷新且能量足时点EX，命中后按实际提示交克拉蕾。
input.en: Use EX when refresh is needed and affordable; hand to Claret through the actual prompt after hitting.

trigger.zh: 丽娜在前台；检查人偶是否已经返回，不按永久增益处理。
trigger.en: Rina is active; check whether the dolls returned rather than assuming permanent coverage.

complete.zh: 人偶攻击给核心穿透，两个都返回就结束；潜能1阶起可自动续攻击，2阶起攻防另看所选阶数。
complete.en: Attacking dolls supply core PEN, ending when both return; Potential rank 1 adds automatic attacks, while rank 2+ ATK/DEF follows the selected rank.

reason.zh: 把辅助刷新放在克拉蕾后台续招时；支援类别以实际提示为准。
reason.en: Refresh support during Claret’s committed off-field attack; use the actual type of entry prompt.

fallback.zh: EX不可用可用普通普攻／特殊技派人偶，再普通切克拉蕾并跳过下一支援事件；已有覆盖也须明确切回。
fallback.en: Without EX, dispatch dolls with normal Basic/Special, then switch normally to Claret and skip the next assist event; existing coverage still requires returning to her.

signal.zh: 只有真实连携窗口才选克拉蕾；仅有快支或无窗口时普通切回并跳过连携。
signal.en: Choose Claret only in a real Chain window; with only Quick Assist or no prompt, switch normally and skip the Chain.

label.zh: 长E已接出的余段；只有实际继续命中才计毁伤。
label.en: Committed remaining held-Special cuts; count Maim only when they actually continue and hit.

title.en: Take only an actual Claret Chain Attack

input.zh: 真实连携选择窗口出现时选择克拉蕾。
input.en: Choose Claret when a real Chain selection appears.

trigger.zh: 上一步确实触发连携；猩红剩余时间与目标状态仍可用。
trigger.en: The previous action truly triggered a Chain; Crimson time and target state remain usable.

complete.zh: 连携延长猩红2秒；按命中查看残痕，不保证必得1层或再次连携。
complete.en: The Chain adds two seconds to Crimson; inspect Gash from actual hits, without guaranteeing one stack or another Chain.

reason.zh: 保留原文连携衔接思路，去掉Boss固定双连携前提。
reason.en: Keep the authored Chain link while removing the Boss-specific double-Chain assumption.

fallback.zh: 仅有快支或没有窗口就普通切回，跳过本步；猩红已结束先恢复，勿把连携当作重新开状态。
fallback.en: With only Quick Assist or no prompt, switch normally and skip. Restore expired Crimson separately; a Chain is not state activation.

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

title.zh: 用锻星积残痕，失衡前保留3层
title.en: Build Gash with Starforging; keep three before Stun

input.zh: 合法衔接第三段后长按／连按普攻；松开会跳劈收尾。
input.en: After a legal link to the third Basic, hold/tap Basic to extend it; releasing ends with the leap slash.

trigger.zh: 猩红铭刻仍有效；从EX后可接第三段，否则按正常连段进入。
trigger.en: Crimson Inscription remains active; EX links to the third Basic, otherwise reach it through the normal combo.

complete.zh: 按目标实际残痕计数，最多3层；只有成功极限闪避才计闪避收益。
complete.en: Read actual target Gash, max three; count dodge benefits only after a successful Perfect Dodge.

reason.zh: 积蓄受配置和命中影响，不用固定普攻次数保证满层。
reason.en: Buildup depends on configuration and hits, so no fixed Basic count guarantees full stacks.

fallback.zh: 状态结束就用可用EX重开；目标移动就先追近，临近失衡时保留已攒残痕。
fallback.en: If the state expires, reactivate with an available EX; approach a moving target and preserve Gash near Stun.

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

title.en: Use Claret’s Ultimate only when personally ready

input.zh: 本人喧响就绪且窗口仍够时按终结技，之后重查残痕。
input.en: Press Ultimate when Claret’s own Decibels are ready and enough window remains, then recheck Gash.

trigger.zh: 不是队友Q或连携替代；目标可命中，辅助仍覆盖。
trigger.en: This is neither a teammate Ultimate nor a Chain replacement; the target is hittable and support still applies.

complete.zh: 发动回复10锐能；残痕按真实积蓄，不能固定当作加1层。
complete.en: Activation restores 10 Sharpness; Gash comes from actual buildup, not a guaranteed extra stack.

reason.zh: 用已就绪资源连接后续毁伤，不强等终结技拖掉失衡。
reason.en: Use ready resources to connect into Maim without waiting out Stun for an Ultimate.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪就跳过，用可命中普攻补缺口；窗口结束立即回循环。
fallback.en: Skip if not ready, fill the gap with connecting Basics, and return to the loop when the window closes.

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

title.zh: 按真实残痕收尾，不预设六毁伤
title.en: Finish from actual Gash; do not promise six Maims

input.zh: 目标重新满3残痕且时间够时长E三横斩；成功毁伤后可普攻伏钺。
input.en: At three renewed Gash with enough time, hold Special for three cuts; a successful Maim permits Subduing Axe afterward.

trigger.zh: 猩红仍有效，残痕与剩余窗口均真实满足。
trigger.en: Crimson, actual Gash and the remaining window all support the sequence.

complete.zh: 只记录真正命中、消耗残痕的毁伤；6影独立触发另算，不混成固定次数。
complete.en: Count only connecting Maims spending Gash; M6 independent triggers are separate, not a fixed total.

reason.zh: 同一手法会因命中、配置与Boss窗口缩短，保留可执行退路。
reason.en: Hits, configuration and Boss windows can shorten the sequence, so preserve a valid fallback.

fallback.zh: 只有1至2层就点E逐次消耗；无残痕、状态结束或敌人无敌就停手回循环，不硬补三连。
fallback.en: With one or two Gash, use individual tap-Special cuts. With none, expired Crimson or invulnerability, stop and return to the loop.

label.zh: 人偶在外场才有核心增益；潜能加成按所选阶数与实际覆盖。
label.en: Core buffs require dolls out; Potential benefits follow the selected rank and actual coverage.

text.zh: 丽娜未开潜能：没有晨间／午夜清扫，也没有潜能攻防；两个手动派出的人偶都返回后及时补覆盖。
text.en: Rina without Potential has no Morning/Midnight Cleanup or Potential ATK/DEF; refresh coverage after both manually dispatched dolls return.

text.zh: 丽娜潜能1阶起，EX／连携／Q后进入13秒一尘不染，期间每2.5秒自动清扫并累积惊吓；6层后下一次晨间改午夜。实际清扫发动会重置人偶离场计时，不按永久覆盖。
text.en: From Rina Potential rank 1, EX/Chain/Ultimate grants 13s Spotless with Cleanup every 2.5s and Fright buildup; at six stacks, the next Morning Cleanup becomes Midnight Cleanup. Actual Cleanup resets doll exit timers, without permanent coverage.

text.zh: 丽娜潜能1阶只开启自动清扫，本阶没有完美侍奉的攻击／防御加成。
text.en: Rina Potential rank 1 enables Cleanup only; it does not yet grant Perfect Service ATK/DEF.

text.zh: 丽娜潜能2阶：核心人偶增益存在时，每1%本人穿透率提供3攻击／2.5防御；上限576／468，实际按当前面板，不能直接当满额。克拉蕾的锐化伤害主要受防御收益影响。
text.en: Rina Potential rank 2: while her core doll buff is active, each 1% of her PEN Ratio grants 3 ATK / 2.5 DEF, capped at 576 / 468. Use actual stats, not automatic caps; DEF is the relevant scaling benefit for Claret’s Sharp DMG.

text.zh: 丽娜潜能3阶：核心人偶增益存在时，每1%本人穿透率提供4.2攻击／3.5防御；上限576／468，实际按当前面板，不能直接当满额。克拉蕾的锐化伤害主要受防御收益影响。
text.en: Rina Potential rank 3: while her core doll buff is active, each 1% of her PEN Ratio grants 4.2 ATK / 3.5 DEF, capped at 576 / 468. Use actual stats, not automatic caps; DEF is the relevant scaling benefit for Claret’s Sharp DMG.

text.zh: 丽娜潜能4阶：核心人偶增益存在时，每1%本人穿透率提供5.5攻击／4.5防御；上限576／468，实际按当前面板，不能直接当满额。克拉蕾的锐化伤害主要受防御收益影响。
text.en: Rina Potential rank 4: while her core doll buff is active, each 1% of her PEN Ratio grants 5.5 ATK / 4.5 DEF, capped at 576 / 468. Use actual stats, not automatic caps; DEF is the relevant scaling benefit for Claret’s Sharp DMG.

text.zh: 丽娜潜能5阶：核心人偶增益存在时，每1%本人穿透率提供6.7攻击／5.5防御；上限576／468，实际按当前面板，不能直接当满额。克拉蕾的锐化伤害主要受防御收益影响。
text.en: Rina Potential rank 5: while her core doll buff is active, each 1% of her PEN Ratio grants 6.7 ATK / 5.5 DEF, capped at 576 / 468. Use actual stats, not automatic caps; DEF is the relevant scaling benefit for Claret’s Sharp DMG.

text.zh: 丽娜潜能6阶：核心人偶增益存在时，每1%本人穿透率提供8攻击／6.5防御；上限576／468，实际按当前面板，不能直接当满额。克拉蕾的锐化伤害主要受防御收益影响。
text.en: Rina Potential rank 6: while her core doll buff is active, each 1% of her PEN Ratio grants 8 ATK / 6.5 DEF, capped at 576 / 468. Use actual stats, not automatic caps; DEF is the relevant scaling benefit for Claret’s Sharp DMG.

text.zh: 克拉蕾1影积蓄提升要实际打出锐暴，不能仅凭持有影画假定固定普攻次数满残痕。
text.en: Claret M1 buildup improvement needs an actual Laceration hit; ownership alone does not guarantee full Gash in a fixed Basic count.

text.zh: 克拉蕾2影延长猩红上限；忽略电抗的条件是猩红中或指定连携／Q／反制／支援突击期间，不是全程无条件。
text.en: Claret M2 extends Crimson; Electric RES ignore applies in Crimson or the specified Chain/Ultimate/Counter/Follow-Up actions, not unconditionally.

text.zh: 克拉蕾4影可延长第三段连斩；仍按命中和残痕停止，别为长按把辅助／失衡窗口耗完。
text.en: Claret M4 allows longer third-hit slashing; stop according to hits and Gash rather than exhausting support/Stun windows.

text.zh: 克拉蕾6影的连携／Q重击命中额外单体毁伤不消耗残痕；独立计入，不因此保证固定九毁伤。
text.en: Claret M6 Chain/Ultimate heavy hits add a separate single-target Maim without spending Gash; this does not guarantee a fixed nine-Maim window.

text.zh: 洛克茜1影减抗要敬请安息炮击实际命中；刚开始转圈不算已触发。
text.en: Roxy M1 RES reduction requires Kindly Rest in Peace to hit; starting the spin is not enough.

text.zh: 洛克茜2影才可用实际引爆风眼积累的流势，在旋转中切后台续转：每层0.2秒，最多0.6秒；基础版本仍先收招。
text.en: Only Roxy M2 permits off-field spinning using Momentum from actual Eye detonations: 0.2 seconds per stack, at most 0.6 seconds. The baseline ends the spin first.

text.zh: 洛克茜6影巨型风涡后续回响要先真的引爆3风眼；每次普通抛锤不保证触发。
text.en: Roxy M6 giant-vortex echoes require three Eyes actually detonated together; an ordinary throw does not guarantee them.

text.zh: 丽娜1影延长人偶停留，额外核心效果仍要求角色在任一人偶10米内；不能当作全图永久增益。
text.en: Rina M1 extends doll presence, but its stronger core effect requires the character within 10 m of a doll; it is not a permanent map-wide buff.

text.zh: 丽娜4影回能要求两个人偶都在外场；任一返回就停止，不能直接等同克拉蕾锐能回复。
text.en: Rina M4 Energy Regen requires both dolls out and ends when either returns; it is not Claret Sharpness recovery.

text.zh: 丽娜6影电伤需EX／连携／Q实际命中并只持续8秒；按本轮覆盖检查，不默认整段持续。
text.en: Rina M6 Electric DMG needs an EX/Chain/Ultimate hit and lasts eight seconds; check coverage rather than assuming the whole window.

text.zh: 克拉蕾专武的电属性锐化增伤由本人EX或毁伤触发；持有专武不保证200%暴率或每次锐暴。
text.en: Claret’s signature Electric Sharp bonus needs her EX or Maim; ownership does not guarantee 200% CRIT Rate or every Laceration check.

text.zh: 洛克茜专武要本人EX造成风伤才触发失衡与队友增伤，仍核对命中；不保证开场满暴或满风能。
text.en: Roxy’s signature needs her EX Wind DMG for Daze/team bonuses; verify hits, without assuming maximum opening CRIT or Wind Energy.

text.zh: 丽娜专武的队伍增伤按本人实际持续命中刷新；人偶返回后不能继续假定满层覆盖。
text.en: Rina’s signature team bonus refreshes from her actual repeated hits; after dolls return, do not assume continued maximum coverage.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.洛克茜转圈，确认风化与资源再收招: 长按特殊技，再松开并停方向，炮击出手再切
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.丽娜派出人偶，再交克拉蕾: 丽娜点强化特殊技，等克拉蕾提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.克拉蕾按当前形态接快支: 看到克拉蕾的快支提示再进场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.克拉蕾开猩红铭刻: 锐能足够时点强化特殊技，再接普攻第三段
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.用锻星积残痕，失衡前保留3层: 长按或连按普攻积残痕，失衡前留3层
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.远离失衡时单毁伤，再接伏钺: 点特殊技，确认毁伤后才接普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.洛克茜接真实招架，再支援突击: 可招架时切洛克茜，成功后点普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.满残痕长E，首次毁伤后再合轴: 长按特殊技，第一次毁伤后才切丽娜
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.只接真实克拉蕾连携: 实际出现连携时选克拉蕾
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.本人Q就绪再接终结技: 自己的终结技就绪时使用
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按真实残痕收尾，不预设六毁伤: 满3残痕长按特殊技，毁伤后可接普攻

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.能量足时长按E贴近目标；松E并停方向，让炮击接出后切丽娜。: 能量够时靠近目标，长按特殊技键启动强化特殊技。松开特殊技键并停止方向输入，等炮击出手后切丽娜。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.需要刷新且能量足时点EX，命中后按实际提示交克拉蕾。: 需要刷新人偶、能量够时点按强化特殊技；命中后按实际出现的提示交给克拉蕾。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.非猩红且锐能足时点EX，随后按普攻接第三段。: 还没进入猩红铭刻、锐能足够时点按强化特殊技；再按普攻接第三段。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.猩红中点E；真实毁伤成功后按普攻伏钺，再接锻星第三段。: 在猩红铭刻中点按特殊技；确实触发毁伤后，按普攻发动伏钺，再接普攻第三段。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.可招架攻击将至时切洛克茜，成功后按普攻接午夜守则。: 可招架攻击将至时按对应支援键切洛克茜；招架成功后点普攻接支援突击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.猩红中长按E，经上挑进入三横斩；第一次毁伤确实出现后再普通切丽娜。: 在猩红铭刻中长按特殊技，经上挑进入三次横斩；确认第一次毁伤已发生，再普通切丽娜。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.目标重新满3残痕且时间够时长E三横斩；成功毁伤后可普攻伏钺。: 目标身上重新有3层残痕且窗口足够时，长按特殊技打三次横斩；确实触发毁伤后可按普攻接伏钺。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1611: 非猩红铭刻且锐能足够时按强化特殊技进入姿态；已在铭刻中则用相应普攻积残痕。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.121100004: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，等人偶下砸命中

161100002: 已接入第三段才持续长按或连点普攻；松手才是跳劈收尾，不必为续段重打一至二段。
After entering hit 3, hold or repeatedly tap Basic to continue. Release to end with the leap; do not replay hits 1–2.
161100005: 强化特殊技前不用打普攻。出招后按普攻直接衔接第三段；本路线需要这段，不是再从第一段打三下。
No Basic required before EX. Afterwards, link Basic directly into hit 3 on this route rather than tapping from hit 1.
161100006: 先点特殊技，并确认毁伤已经触发；再按普攻发动伏钺并接第三段。没触发就不抢按。
Use Special first and confirm the Maim trigger, then use Basic for the follow-up and link into hit 3. Do not input it before the trigger.
161100007: 本步先长按特殊技；确认毁伤后才可选点普攻接伏钺，不是三次横斩各按一次。
Hold Special first. Optionally tap Basic after a confirmed Maim; the three slashes do not each require a Basic input.
162100014: 招架成功后点普攻才接支援突击；普通切入不产生这个普攻入口。
After a successful parry, tap Basic for the Assist Follow-Up. A normal switch does not create this entry.

1611: 进铭刻的强化特殊技之前不用普攻；已在姿态中，才按本路线用普攻积残痕。
No Basic is required before the EX stance entry. Use the Basic buildup route if already in that stance.
